title: EG&G engineer's account of an egg-shaped craft that could not be opened

tellings.quote: The senior EG&G engineer described to my great uncle that it was egg-shaped about the size of a SUV.

plain: A senior engineer at EG&G, a US defense contractor, described to a relative an egg-shaped craft about the size of an SUV that no one could open. Michels relays this in his episode with Jake Barber, a man who says he retrieved a UFO by helicopter, passing on what the engineer told a great uncle. If true, it would mean contractors held an object they could not get inside.
